text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout for release 2026.03.20-rc7 -> chat-service v2.1.0
mike: seeing a small spike in 500s in eu-west at 5% traffic, telemetry graph: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/abc123
sara: confirmed, p95 latency +120ms and error rate from /generate up ~0.7% vs baseline
anjali: logs show "response-length-exceeded" from model-wrapper on a few long-context probes
kevin: could be new tokenization edge on v2.1.0 quantization profile. any repro ids?
lina: pushed a quick probe set, repro ids: r-9981, r-9982 (both long-system+few-chunks)
ops-rotation: do we want to pause and pin back to v2.0.5 in eu-west while we investigate?
mike: yes pause please. hold traffic at 5% and pin routing to stable for user traffic
deploy-bot: pausing rollout in eu-west-1 at 5% (initiated by ops-rotation).
deploy-bot: queued pin action: /infra pin-version --service=chat --region=eu-west-1 --version=v2.0.5
sara: adding one more datapoint — a canary trace shows chunking behavior differs when seq_len > 2048
anjali: reproduced locally with the same model + quant profile; looks like kernel-selection used a low-memory path that mis-estimates max_tokens
kevin: ok plan: rollback traffic pin + create bug for kernel selection. priority P0 for rollback and hotfix for quant profile
lina: I've posted the rollback command in #eng-releases-runbook: 
```
# pin stable
infractl route pin --service chat --region eu-west-1 --version v2.0.5 --note "pause rc7 rollout due to response-length errors"
```
mike: also put a short blurb in release notes and notify customers in change window. link: https://redwood.in/release/2026-03-20-rc7/notes
ops-rotation: SD: change window is still open for 2 hours, we should be safe to pin and then schedule a rollback if needed
deploy-bot: pin succeeded: chat-service eu-west-1 -> v2.0.5 (traffic pinned at 100% for stable; canary halted)
kevin: creating issue INF-4221 with repro and logs, tagging runtime and infra teams
sara: adding eval set for long-context prompts to the regression suite, will run nightly
anjali: once INF-4221 has a hotfix candidate, let's run a shadow canary for kernel selection changes before re-running staged rollout
mike: agreed. decision: pause rollout, pin to v2.0.5, create bug, run shadow canary. no rollback to older infra needed beyond the pin.
lina: I notified account ops for customers in eu-west on the change and put an incident note on the release page :email:
ops-rotation: thumbs up from oncall, marking this thread as stop/go: STOP -> paused at 5%
deploy-bot: update: release pipeline stage "canary" failed gating metric -> paused. will post when re-opened or if we roll back further
